key.name: animation
key.description: A short animation with the battery level, the charging speed and the time to full when a charger is connected. Full screen while locked, a small banner while using the phone.

key.name: wake-screen
key.summary: Turn the screen on to show it
key.description: With the display off, plugging in turns it on for a few seconds (off again if not touched). Not in a pocket, during a call, or while Do Not Disturb keeps the screen dark.

key.name: sound
key.description: A short sound when a charger is connected or disconnected. Silent in silent mode and during Do Not Disturb.

key.name: vibrate
key.description: A short vibration when a charger is connected or disconnected (follows the system vibration setting; not during Do Not Disturb).

key.name: lockscreen-info
key.summary: Show charging info on lock screen
key.description: While a charger is connected, a line under the clock: charging speed, level and time to full, or why charging is paused.

key.name: preview-request
key.description: Bumped by the Settings page; Lomiri plays the charging animation once with the current readings.
